newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African all-shares stage record close, off highs.
newsitem.headline: S.African all-shares stage record close, off highs.

text.p: The South African all-share index ended at a record high for the second day running, but hugged Monday's levels as the market lost steam during the day. Golds eased on a dull bullion price.
Dealers said there was general disappointment that the market failed to ride further on the back of strong world markets, some of which also set record highs.
The market was seen carrying on better during the week and the U.S. CPI figure due on Wednesday would provide direction, dealers said.
The overall index ended up 1.6 points to 7,073.1 points, golds gained 7.7 points to 8,306 points and golds were down 11.7 points to 1,723.5 points.
